user.title: Sign in to South East Water
user.description: Enter the email address and password you use for my.southeastwater.com.au. The portal will then send you a one-time code.

mfa_channel.title: Where should the code be sent?
mfa_channel.description: South East Water requires a one-time code for every new login. Choose how to receive it.

mfa_code.title: Enter the one-time code
mfa_code.description: Type the 6-digit code South East Water just sent you.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {username} has expired. Continue to request a new one-time code.

reauth_password.title: Update password
reauth_password.description: The saved password for {username} was rejected. Enter the current password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the South East Water portal.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or password was not accepted.
error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.no_mfa_channel: The portal did not offer a way to send a code.
error.unknown: The portal responded unexpectedly. Check the logs for details.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the South East Water portal.
abort.invalid_auth: The portal rejected the session before setup could finish.
abort.unknown: The portal responded unexpectedly. Check the logs for details.
abort.wrong_account: The account you signed in to does not match this entry.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between polls. At the default of 1440 the poll runs once a day at 2 AM local time, when the previous day's readings are usually available.

force_import.name: Force import
force_import.description: Poll the portal now instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll.

import_from_date.name: Import from date
import_from_date.description: Import every day from the given date up to yesterday into long-term statistics.

no_entries.message: South East Water is not set up.

start_in_future.message: The start date must be before today.
